title: office.recall-answer request
description: A recall question answered with at most one Standard-tier model call over office.recall evidence. The filters are office.recall's; the question is required (feed mode is office.recall only).

question.description: The question. Recall selects evidence with it as literal case-insensitive terms, as office.recall does.

session_id.description: Exact engine session identity; only that session's conversation source contributes. Filters both question and feed mode.

since.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC start of day).

until.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC end of day).

limit.description: Maximum matching public or private entries recall selects as evidence.
